title: Technology Sector Update for 12/20/2018: BILI, BABA, ERIC, QTRH, MSFT, AAPL, IBM, CSCO, GOOG - Nasdaq.com
text:
Shutterstock photo Top Technology Stocks:
MSFT: -0.18%
AAPL: -0.56%
IBM: -0.15%
CSCO: -0.02%
GOOG: FLAT
Most technology stocks were declining pre-bell Thursday.
Early movers include:
(+) Bilibili ( BILI ), which was up more than 5% after announcing a business collaboration agreement with Taobao Marketplace, a mobile commerce unit of Alibaba Group ( BABA ).
In other sector news:
(+) Mobile operator Tigo Senegal said pre-market Thursday that it has chosen Ericsson ( ERIC ) to lead its nationwide network modernization project as it looks to accelerate digitalization in the telecommunications market. Ericsson was up almost 1% after the news.
(-) Quarterhill ( QTRH ) was down more than 1% as its indirect subsidiary Polaris Innovations granted a term license for certain patents to Powerchip Technology Corporation.
